evals.name: dirty-repo-dry-run
evals.prompt: I want spec kit artifacts for my repo at {FIXTURE} — it's a little word-count tool. Just do the dry run for now so I can see the plan, don't launch the actual run. Put any scratch copies or snapshots under {SNAPS}.
evals.expected_output: A frozen snapshot at the committed HEAD, a passing reverse dry run numbered 001, no launch, source untouched, and a report that says uncommitted changes were left out.

evals.name: plain-dir-dry-run
evals.prompt: {FIXTURE} is a folder (not a git repo) with some backup scripts. Can you reverse engineer it into speckit specs? For now only prepare everything and show me the dry run; don't start the LLM run. Scratch space: {SNAPS}
evals.expected_output: A snapshot copy made into its own git repo, node_modules excluded, a passing dry run, no launch, and no .git created in the source.

evals.name: existing-specs-worktree-dry-run
evals.prompt: reverse engineer {FIXTURE} into an as-is spec kit feature, and include my uncommitted changes. there are already a couple of features in specs/. dry run only please, no launch. use {SNAPS} for snapshots
evals.expected_output: A worktree snapshot containing the uncommitted edit, feature numbered 003, a passing dry run, no launch, source untouched.

evals.name: live-full-run
evals.prompt: Reverse-engineer {FIXTURE} into a complete as-is Spec Kit feature (all the artifacts) and bring it back into the repo's specs/. Run it for real. Use {SNAPS} for any snapshot or scratch copy. Don't commit anything.
evals.expected_output: All gates approved; the feature copied into fixture/specs and lint-clean at --upto 5; no commit in the source; snapshot clean apart from specs/ and .specstride/; spot-checks reported; a MoL draft contract derived from the as-is feature.
